Thank you for voting!

Your vote in the Monroe Humane membership shirt design contest has been received. We'll announce the winning design soon — stay tuned on social media and at the shelter!

What happens next

Once voting closes, the design with the most votes becomes the official HSMC membership shirt. Members who voted will be among the first to know the result.

  • Follow us on Facebook and Instagram for the announcement.
  • Check back at the Events page for the unveiling event details.
  • Become a member to get your shirt: Membership plans.
